人物.line: Qi's strategist, a descendant of Sun Wu. He plans from a wooden cart, never on the field.
人物.lineZh: 齐国谋士，孙武之后，在小木车上出主意，从不上阵。

story.en: Sun Bin was a descendant of Sun Wu, the man who wrote The Art of War. He studied strategy beside Pang Juan — and Pang Juan, once he held a command in Wei, had his old classmate's kneecaps cut out rather than let him be used by anyone else.
story.zh: 孙膑是孙武的后人。他和庞涓一起学兵法；庞涓当上魏国将军后，怕他被别国所用，先下手砍掉了他的膝盖骨。

story.en: He got out of Wei in a cart, hidden by an envoy of Qi. In Qi he won the trust of the general Tian Ji with a horse race that looked like a certain loss: send the worst horse against their best, then win the other two. Three races, three wins, nothing bought.
story.zh: 他坐在车里、藏在齐国使者的车中逃出魏国。到齐国后，靠一场赛马赢得将军田忌的信任：下等马对他们的上等马，剩下两场全赢，一分钱没花。

story.en: In 354 BC Wei's army had Handan surrounded. Sun Bin did not march on Handan. He struck at Wei's own capital instead, and Pang Juan had to turn his army around — the siege lifted itself. Twelve years later at Maling, Sun Bin had his men count the campfires down from a hundred thousand to thirty thousand a night. Pang Juan, sure that Qi's soldiers were deserting, raced ahead with the fast troops and rode into the ambush.
story.zh: 公元前 354 年，魏军围住邯郸。孙膑不去邯郸，直扑魏国都城，庞涓只能回头——围自然就解了。十二年后马陵，孙膑让人一夜夜把灶减少：十万、五万、三万。庞涓以为齐军逃了大半，带轻兵急追，一头撞进埋伏。

人物.line: Wei's general. His troops have Handan surrounded when news comes that Wei's own capital is in danger.
人物.lineZh: 魏国将军，精兵围着邯郸，忽然听说都城危急。

人物.line: The ruler of Qi. He asked Sun Bin about the art of war, took him as his teacher, and sent him to rescue Zhao.
人物.lineZh: 齐国国君，问孙膑兵法、拜他为师；救赵就是他派孙膑去的。

人物.line: Emperor Wen of Sui. In 589 his armies cross the river and end the Chen dynasty.
人物.lineZh: 隋朝开国皇帝，589 年南下灭陈。

人物.line: Qi's general. His first instinct: march straight at Handan and fight — the obvious plan.
人物.lineZh: 齐国将军，第一反应是直奔邯郸、正面打。

人物.line: A Sui general on the Yangtze frontier. He swapped his garrison in plain sight until Chen stopped watching.
人物.lineZh: 隋朝将领，在长江前线反复换防，让陈军看惯了。

人物.line: The last emperor of Chen, in Jiankang. Across the river, the frontier looked quiet to him.
人物.lineZh: 陈朝末代皇帝，隔着江，他觉得前线很安静。

人物.line: The ruler of Zheng. He wanted Kuai's land, so he wrote its best men a promise and buried it outside their gate.
人物.lineZh: 郑国国君，想要郐国的地，就把郐国能人的名字写成盟书，埋在城门外。

episodes.en: Borrow a knife to kill a person
